printers.title: Printers
printers.description: Receipts and invoices print straight to these printers, without a dialog. Works offline too.
printers.autoPrint: Print the receipt automatically after each sale
printers.cut: Cut the paper after each receipt (only if the printer doesn't already)

calibration.box: BOTH SIDES OF THIS BOX MUST PRINT

drawer.title: Cash drawer
drawer.description: Opens by itself for cash sales. Every opening is recorded with the person, the till and the reason, even offline.

drawer.badPulse: Pulse length must be 50 to 500 ms
drawer.needsPermission: Testing the drawer needs the "Open the cash drawer" permission.
drawer.saveFailed: Couldn't save the drawer settings. Check the values.

display.description: Shows the customer each item and the total while you ring up, then the change. Works offline.
